Version A — the sidebar tag list — feels the most natural to me. Having my tags sitting right there in the side panel with a count next to each, where I just click "Recipes" to narrow down, is how I'd instinctively browse. It also lets me see all my tags at a glance, which the dropdown hides until I open it. Version C's dropdown was fine and B's clickable chip was handy too, but the sidebar is my pick.

Your assumptions are right: two recipe bookmarks and one unrelated one is a good little test, and after filtering it clearly shows "Recipes" as the active tag with "2 bookmarks" as the count — that's exactly the reassurance I'd want that the filter actually took effect. Good.
